manifest_entries.notes: U.S. Electric Power Transmission Lines (Archive). ArcGIS item d4090758322c4d32a4cd002ffaa0aa12, owner Federal_User_Community, org FiaPA4ga0iQKduv3 (atlas.eia.gov / atlas-eia.opendata.arcgis.com). Source FeatureServer: https://services2.arcgis.com/FiaPA4ga0iQKduv3/arcgis/rest/services/US_Electric_Power_Transmission_Lines/FeatureServer/0 (94,619 features; native service spatialReference wkid 102100/3857). This layer is explicitly ARCHIVED by EIA/Esri ('will no longer be updated or maintained'); last data update 2024-09-30. The ArcGIS Hub download API (v1) resolves to a short-lived signed Azure Blob SAS URL (valid ~1 hour) -- the URL recorded here is the stable, re-runnable Hub API endpoint, not the ephemeral blob URL. IMPORTANT CRS GOTCHA (verified by direct test): calling this endpoint WITHOUT '&spatialRefId=4326' silently returns coordinates in EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator meters) while still labeling the file '.geojson' (and even sets crs.properties.name to the string 'EPSG:3857', which is itself non-conformant with the GeoJSON spec, RFC 7946, which mandates WGS84 lon/lat). The URL recorded here includes the explicit 'spatialRefId=4326' parameter, which was verified to produce true EPSG:4326 lon/lat coordinates (sample first vertex [-84.4173197616516, 42.7338682369586], a plausible Michigan location) -- always pass this parameter explicitly, never rely on the default. VOLTAGE=-999999 and OWNER/VOLT_CLASS/STATUS/TYPE='NOT AVAILABLE' are explicit no-data sentinels in this dataset, not genuine zero/blank -- treat as UNKNOWN. SUB_1/SUB_2 (origin/destination 'substation' name strings) frequently contain placeholder values such as 'UNKNOWN######' or 'TAP######' and must NOT be treated as a verified substation inventory or geocoded location.

Power Plants in the U.S. ArcGIS item b063316fac7345dba4bae96eaa813b2f, owner Federal_User_Community, org FiaPA4ga0iQKduv3 (atlas.eia.gov). Source FeatureServer: https://services2.arcgis.com/FiaPA4ga0iQKduv3/arcgis/rest/services/Power_Plants_in_the_US/FeatureServer/0. Live FeatureServer query (returnCountOnly) reported 13,446 features at query time; this GeoJSON export contains 13,445 features (one fewer), reproduced identically across two independent export requests -- cause not verified (possibly one null/invalid-geometry record silently dropped by the exporter); treat as a small, apparently-stable discrepancy, not a download error. Data vintage: the 'Period' field is uniformly '202502' (February 2025, EIA-860M) across all records -- use this field, not the ArcGIS item 'modified' timestamp, as the authoritative data-currency indicator (the item's 'modified'/'checked monthly' claim does not guarantee the underlying Period has advanced). Same CRS gotcha as the transmission-lines entry above: '&spatialRefId=4326' was required and verified (sample point [-84.2949699996921, 45.3628199997005], Tower, MI) -- the default (no spatialRefId) returns EPSG:3857 meters mislabeled as '.geojson'. Includes ALL operable plants >=1 MW nameplate (operating, standby, and short/long-term out of service are all included per the item description) with NO explicit status/operating-state column exposed in this layer -- Total_MW=0 for a given fuel is not reliable evidence a unit is retired. Several *_MW fields (Bat_MW, Bio_MW, Geo_MW, Other_MW) are declared esriFieldTypeString(4000) in the schema despite carrying unquoted numeric JSON values in query/export responses -- coerce to numeric explicitly and verify null vs 0 handling per field.

Natural Gas Interstate and Intrastate Pipelines. ArcGIS item 9833ca6c8103490b8ad145a30f0522ee, owner Federal_User_Community, org FiaPA4ga0iQKduv3 (atlas.eia.gov). Source FeatureServer: https://services2.arcgis.com/FiaPA4ga0iQKduv3/arcgis/rest/services/Natural_Gas_Interstate_and_Intrastate_Pipelines_1/FeatureServer/0 (32,892 features; native service spatialReference wkid 102100/3857). Unlike the other two items, this endpoint's default response (no spatialRefId param needed) was verified to already be true EPSG:4326 (crs='urn:ogc:def:crs:OGC:1.3:CRS84'; sample coordinate [-80.588928, 40.397824], a plausible Pennsylvania location) -- the Hub download API's default CRS behavior is inconsistent across items/layers, so always verify crs and coordinate magnitude per file rather than assuming. Minimal attributes only: TYPEPIPE (Interstate/Intrastate), Operator, Status. Observed Status has a single distinct value 'Operating' across all 32,892 features (no inactive/abandoned segments present) even though the field's own description text mentions Active/Inactive/Abandoned as 'common statuses' -- i.e. the described domain is broader than what is actually populated right now. No pipeline diameter, capacity/throughput, or commodity-rate attributes are present. No date/vintage field exists in this layer; data currency can only be inferred from the ArcGIS item 'modified' timestamp (checked monthly per item snippet), which is a weaker provenance signal than the Period field available on the Power Plants layer.

Underlying data: NOAA NCEI U.S. Climate Normals 1991-2020, Monthly/Annual/Seasonal Gridded Normals (nClimGrid-based), NCEI Accession 0245564, DOI 10.25921/yya9-9769. Verified directly from file: GeoTIFF tag 42113 (GDAL_NODATA)=NaN; CRS EPSG:4326/WGS84 (GeoKey 2048=4326); pixel size 0.04166667 deg (~4.6 km); shape 596 rows x 1385 cols; origin (-124.70833333, 49.37500127); dtype float32. 'tmax_max' band verified empirically (3 sample pixels) to equal max(monthly tmax_norm, 12 months) i.e. the mean daily max of the warmest month. '_flag' bands = number of months/years of input data behind each cell's normal (QA/coverage/confidence input).

manifest_entries.notes: Annual NLCD Land Cover, map year 2024 (time=1704067200000 = 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z, the instant used by the service's time-enabled mosaic to select the 2024 catalog item; this is the latest year this ImageServer currently exposes). Output EPSG:5070 (wikd 5070 confirmed in the exportImage JSON response), exact 30 m pixel grid (487680 m x 449160 m / 30 m = 16256 x 14972 px), nearest-neighbor resampling requested, pixelType U8, declared NoData=250. The 'url' field is the reproducible exportImage request (f=json); the actual bytes were fetched from the ephemeral 'href' the server returned in that JSON response (ArcGIS temp-output URLs expire and are not themselves stable, so do not re-request the href -- re-issue the exportImage call instead). Verified open+valid: 16256x14972 px, uint8, single band, via Pillow/numpy. Histogram cross-check: all 16 official CONUS classes (11,12,21,22,23,24,31,41,42,43,52,71,81,82,90,95) present in plausible proportions for this Gulf-coast bbox, plus 250 NoData (0.267% of pixels) and a notable 2.70% of pixels at value 0, which is NOT a documented Land Cover class (see known_issues).

NOT a separate download -- this is the 'PADUS4_1VectorAnalysis_CONUS.gdb' folder (63 files, 441,838,654 bytes uncompressed) extracted in this session from the already-verified PADUS4_1_Raster_CONUS.zip (see first entry above) using 'unzip ... "PADUS4_1VectorAnalysis_CONUS.gdb/*"', deliberately skipping the zip's huge external raster payload (.ige/.rde/.rrd, ~80 GB uncompressed). Extracted pre-emptively for Phase 2 convenience because this single layer (PADUS4_1_VectorAnalysis_CONUS, 322,263 MultiPolygon features, ESRI:102039 / functionally EPSG:5070) is the recommended primary adapter input -- see docs/research/phase2/usgs_padus.md. sha256 is not meaningful for a directory; integrity is inherited from the parent zip's verified checksum. Safe to delete and re-extract from PADUS4_1_Raster_CONUS.zip at any time if disk space is needed; not required to keep both copies long-term.
